rationale: Strengths: The agent verified identity correctly using full name + zip, inspected the user’s latest (pending) order before acting, found appropriate in-stock 1000ml variants (allowing material change per user preference), executed the modification correctly on the right order, and reported the correct refund amount consistent with tool output. Weakness: The agent proceeded with the order modification without obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact change. The policy requires stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. The agent said “To confirm… I will proceed…” and immediately performed the modification, rather than waiting for the user’s explicit approval. Because of this confirmation step violation, the interaction does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise correct actions and information.
